source.title: Mid-Ulster Mail, 6 May 1939, p. 6 ("Magherafelt District Council")
source.publisher: Mid-Ulster Mail (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: Nominations from the Mid-Ulster Mail (6 May 1939, p. 6). Contests at Bellaghy and Clady noted in the same report. Bellaghy figures from the Mid-Ulster Mail (10 June 1939, p. 8); Clady unopposed after a withdrawal (Mid-Ulster Mail, 13 May 1939, p. 5) (meetings gap-fill, 7 Nov 2026).

note: Triennial election, polled Friday 2 June 1939. Twenty-four of the twenty-six divisions were uncontested; Bellaghy was polled; Clady had two nominations but Mrs. A. O'Kane withdrew. Co. Londonderry polled Friday 2 June 1939: 'Polling in the Enagh Lough Division ... took place yesterday' (Londonderry Sentinel, 3 June 1939, p. 8). Re-filed from 1939-05-31, a provisional date (gap-fill 6 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
